original.statement: An experimental environment variable ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION was added to the agent Deployment to control lazy creation of Envoy statistics; the feature is enabled by default and can be disabled by setting it to false.

corrected.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION environment variable for the agent. It controls a new experimental feature that lazily creates a subset of Envoy statistics, and setting it to false disables the feature.

decision.reason: [ev-62f858bc5c83] adds an experimental lazy Envoy stats feature that "can be disabled by setting ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION to false in agent Deployment", which supports the env-var subject with component agent and change type added. The text never states the literal value "true" as the default; that is only implied by the opt-out wording. Because after is optional for added, the inferred literal is dropped.
